whole_expression_publication_assessment.independent_basis: The registered Pustet 1862 artifact records expiry by publication date and a faithful mechanical facsimile. One complete, uninterrupted old petition supplies every petition word and its entire structure. A second identified locus in the same book supplies the complete conventional conclusion and response. The displayed body contains no newly developed petition, substituted petition clause, or recombination of separate petition structures.
whole_expression_publication_assessment.whole_work_reasoning: The old donor and target do not have identical endings, so the modern complete string cannot be described as one diplomatic old-source transcription. Considered as a whole, the recorded changes comprise pointing, case, line display and addition of a separately old conventional closing formula/response after the unchanged whole petition. This finite combination does not supply a new expressive recasting in the reviewed text. This is an internal project assessment, not a court determination or a rightsholder permission.
whole_expression_publication_assessment.strongest_adverse_argument: A later arrangement can contain protectable original expression even when every individual element is old. Choosing a different conclusion and placing it after a historical petition creates a whole string not printed at that old prayer locus; a bare word-match or small edit count would not resolve originality.
whole_expression_publication_assessment.response_to_adverse_argument: The conclusion is a routine, separately witnessed liturgical formula followed by its conventional response. The entire substantive petition remains intact, with no creative recasting of its order, structure or content. The assessment relies on that whole-expression character and exact source evidence, not a blanket rule that all small edits or all formula substitutions are unprotected. The projection record expressly discloses both old loci and the target comparison.
whole_expression_publication_assessment.authority_separation: The proposed carrier is project-created editorial material under its recorded terms; that label alone does not clear received Latin. The independent Pustet artifact and the separately reviewed per-proper public-domain row supply the underlying-wording basis. The restricted 2008 artifact is a verification witness and is not in publication_source_ids.
